name: @supabase-dx/cli
description: Supabase DX CLI - experimental developer experience tools

scripts.build:prod: tsup && bun build dist/index.js --compile --minify --outfile bin/supa --target=bun && codesign -s - -f bin/supa && mkdir -p bin/pglite bin/auth-migrations bin/config-schema && cp node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite/dist/pglite.wasm node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite/dist/pglite.data bin/pglite/ && cp ../vendor/supabase-auth/migrations/*.up.sql bin/auth-migrations/ && cp config-schema/config.schema.json bin/config-schema/
scripts.build:local: BUILD_TARGET=local tsup && bun build dist/index.js --compile --minify --outfile bin/supa --target=bun && codesign -s - -f bin/supa && mkdir -p bin/pglite bin/auth-migrations bin/config-schema && cp node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite/dist/pglite.wasm node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite/dist/pglite.data bin/pglite/ && cp ../vendor/supabase-auth/migrations/*.up.sql bin/auth-migrations/ && cp config-schema/config.schema.json bin/config-schema/
